tools.name: compare_branches_tags
tools.description: Compare two branches, tags, or commits in a repository

base.description: The base branch, tag, or commit SHA to compare from

head.description: The head branch, tag, or commit SHA to compare to

owner.description: The space address to which the repository belongs (the address path of the enterprise, organization or individual)

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Create a comment on an issue or pull request

number.description: Issue or pull request number (case sensitive, no # prefix needed)

owner.description: The space address to which the repository belongs (enterprise, organization or personal path)

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create an issue

assignee.description: The personal space address of the issue assignee

collaborators.description: The personal space addresses of issue collaborators, separated by commas

issue_type.description: Enterprise custom task type, non-enterprise users must consider it as 'task'

labels.description: Comma-separated labels, name requirements are between 2-20 in length and non-special characters. Example: bug,performance

owner.description: The space address to which the repository belongs (the address path of the enterprise, organization or individual)

security_hole.description: Set as a private issue (default is false)

tools.name: create_pull
tools.description: Create a pull request

assignees.description: The assignees of the pull request, example: (username1,username2)

assignees_number.description: The min number of assignees need accept of the pull request

base.description: The target branch of the pull request

body.description: The body of the pull request

draft.description: Whether to set the pull request as draft

head.description: The source branch of the pull request, Format: branch (master) or: path_with_namespace:branch (oschina/gitee:master)

issue.description: The issue of the pull request

labels.description: The labels of the pull request. example: bug,performance

milestone_number.description: The milestone number of the pull request

owner.description: The space address to which the repository belongs (the address path of the enterprise, organization or individual)

testers.description: The testers of the pull request, example: (username1,username2)

testers_number.description: The min number of testers need accept of the pull request

title.description: The title of the pull request

tools.name: create_release
tools.description: Create a release

owner.description: The space address to which the repository belongs (the address path of the enterprise, organization or individual)

prerelease.description: Whether the release is a prerelease

target_commitish.description: The branch name or commit SHA, defaults to the repository's default branch

tools.name: create_repo
tools.description: Create a repository (user, org, or enterprise)

auto_init.description: Whether to initialize the repository with a README file

enterprise.description: Enterprise path (required when owner_type is enterprise)

org.description: Organization path (required when owner_type is org)

owner_type.description: Owner type: user (personal), org (organization), or enterprise

tools.name: fork_repository
tools.description: Fork a repository

name.description: The name of the forked repository, default is the same as the original repository

organization.description: The full address of the organization space to which the repository belongs, default for current user

owner.description: The space address to which the repository belongs (the address path of the enterprise, organization or individual)

path.description: The path of the forked repository, default is the same as the original repository

tools.description: Get a pull request diff files

number.description: The number of the pull request, must be an integer, not a float

owner.description: The space address to which the repository belongs (the address path of the enterprise, organization or individual)

tools.description: Get the content of the specified file in the repository

owner.description: The space address to which the repository belongs (the address path of the enterprise, organization or individual)

ref.description: The branch name or commit ID

tools.description: Get a pull request detail

number.description: The number of the pull request, must be an integer, not a float

owner.description: The space address to which the repository belongs (the address path of the enterprise, organization or individual)

tools.description: Get the detail of an issue

number.description: Issue number (case sensitive, no # prefix needed)

owner.description: The space address to which the repository belongs (the address path of the enterprise, organization or individual)

tools.description:
This is a tool from the gitee MCP server.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List all comments for an issue or pull request

number.description: Issue or pull request number (case sensitive, no # prefix needed)

owner.description: The space address to which the repository belongs (enterprise, organization or personal path)

per_page.description: Number of results per page, maximum 100

since.description: Only comments updated at or after this time in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: List repository releases

direction.description: Optional. Ascending/descending. Not filled in is ascending

owner.description: The space address to which the repository belongs (the address path of the enterprise, organization or individual)

per_page.description: Number of results per page, maximum 100

tools.name: list_repo_issues
tools.description: List all issues in a repository

filter.description: Filter parameter: assigned to authorized user (assigned), created by authorized user (created), all issues involving authorized user (all). Default: assigned

owner.description: Repository owner's namespace (enterprise, organization or personal path)

per_page.description: Number of items per page, maximum 100

since.description: Start update time in ISO 8601 format

sort.description: Sort field: creation time (created), update time (updated). Default: created

state.description: Issue state: open, progressing, closed, rejected

tools.name: list_repo_pulls
tools.description: List repository pulls

base.description: Target branch name for the pull request

head.description: Source branch of the PR. Format: branch or username:branch

since.description: Start update time in ISO 8601 format

sort.description: Sort field, default by creation time

tools.name: list_user_notifications
tools.description: List all notifications for authorized user

before.description: Only list notifications updated before the given time, requiring the time format to be ISO 8601

participating.description: Only list notifications where the user is directly participating or mentioned

since.description: Only list notifications updated after the given time, requiring the time format to be ISO 8601

type.description: Filter notifications of a specified type, all: all, event: event notification, referer: @ notification

tools.name: list_user_repos
tools.description: List user authorized repositories

direction.description: Sorting direction: ascending (asc), descending (desc). Default: asc

sort.description: Sorting method: creation time (created), update time (updated), last push time (pushed), warehouse ownership and name (full_name). Default: full_name

type.description: Filter user repositories: their creation (owner), personal (personal), their membership (member), public (public), private (private), cannot be used together with visibility or affiliation parameters, otherwise a 422 error will be reported

tools.name: manage_pull_review
tools.description: Manage a pull request review (approve or cancel)

action.description: Action to perform: approve (submit approval) or cancel (reset review status)

force.description: Whether to force approve (only for administrators, valid when action=approve)

number.description: The number of the pull request, must be an integer, not a float

owner.description: The space address to which the repository belongs (enterprise, organization or personal path)

reset_all.description: Whether to reset all reviewers (only for administrators, valid when action=cancel)

tools.name: merge_pull
tools.description: Merge a pull request

close_related_issue.description: Whether to close the related issue after merging

description.description: The description of the merge commit

number.description: The number of the pull request

owner.description: The space address to which the repository belongs (the address path of the enterprise, organization or individual)

prune_source_branch.description: Whether to delete the source branch after merging

title.description: The title of the merge commit

tools.name: search_files_by_content
tools.description: Search files by content in a repository

after_context.description: Number of context lines to include after each match

before_context.description: Number of context lines to include before each match

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return (1-100)

literal_pathspec.description: Treat provided paths as literal strings and disable glob matching

owner.description: The space address to which the repository belongs (the address path of the enterprise, organization or individual)

paths.description: Comma-separated list of paths or glob patterns to limit the search scope

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit to search; defaults to the repository's default branch
